name: Almonds
siboNotes: Generally well tolerated in small portions during SIBO treatment. Stick to 10 almonds or less to minimize potential galactan exposure.
preparationTips: Choose raw or dry-roasted almonds without added seasonings
Soaking almonds overnight may improve digestibility
Almond flour can be used as wheat flour substitute in baking
Store in airtight container to maintain freshness
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin E and healthy monounsaturated fats
Good source of magnesium and fiber
